name: optcatalog_handle_pkt0a_remove_runtime_relay
description: OptCatalog::HandlePkt0A_RemoveRuntimeRelay receives the network remove-runtime relay packet, resolves the entry and owner row, suppresses relay echo, and removes the matching runtime instance. Direct production host: RecoilApp.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent OptCatalog/GameNet packet-handler source-cluster pass.

The retail assembly passes an uninitialized stack scratch for nonzero point vectors instead of copying packet->pointOrVec3; the source preserves that observed behavior and limits the smoke to paths where RemoveRuntimeInstance has no active runtime entries to consume the scratch contents.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4342d0 validates packet optCatalogEntryId lookup, zero-vector detection for nullable point argument, owner row lookup by packet ownerPlayerKey, missing-row zero return, owner save-state/root-node access, temporary g_OptCatalogProcessRuntimeRelayEnabled clear, OptCatalog::RemoveRuntimeInstance(entry, pointOrVec3, ownerRootNode), relay re-enable, and one return for handled rows.
The native pkt0a smoke verifies missing-row zero return, handled zero-vector and nonzero-vector paths, and restoration of g_OptCatalogProcessRuntimeRelayEnabled after RemoveRuntimeInstance returns.
